subject: GCP Marketplace — drawdown sprint proposal & co-sell sequencing
messages:
From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@horizonai.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-12T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Initial drawdown sprint proposal for GCP private offer

Hi Aisha,

Thanks again for the time yesterday — appreciate the transparency on HorizonAI's Q3 forecasting rhythm. Per our conversation, I've sketched a pragmatic drawdown sprint that reduces upfront friction for Procurement while protecting your month-to-month consumption profile. Attached is a simple PO template and a suggested burn schedule (drawdown_schedule_v1.xlsx).

High level proposal: 
- Month 1: Frontload 20% of committed dollars to cover migration + ramp.
- Months 2–4: Smooth burn at ~25%/month.
- Optional quarter 2 top-up if utilization >= 80%.

Co-sell sequencing: Ben will coordinate the GCP PMC handoff so the private-offer redemption triggers the co-sell listing in the marketplace. We think a 10 business-day procurement cycle is realistic if you can sign using the PO template; otherwise we can route via DocuSign.

Next steps (for clarity):
1) Procurement to confirm PO holder and legal reviewer (Aisha).
2) Redwood to send a final PO template and annotated drawdown schedule (Michael).
3) Ben to intro GCP rep for listing and quoting alignment (Ben).

If you want, we can run a short call Friday to walk Procurement through the template.

Thanks,
Michael

--
Michael Grant
Head of Sales, Cloud Partnerships
Redwood Inference
michael.grant@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0142

From: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@horizonai.com>

Cc: Procurement <procurement@horizonai.com>
Date: 2026-08-13T08:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial drawdown sprint proposal for GCP private offer

On Thu, Aug 12, 2026 at 9:14 AM Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com> wrote:
> Hi Aisha,
> 
> Thanks again for the time yesterday — appreciate the transparency on HorizonAI's Q3 forecasting rhythm. Per our conversation, I've sketched a pragmatic drawdown sprint...

Thanks Michael — this looks reasonable and aligns with our fiscal team's ask to avoid heavy frontloads while covering ramp. A couple of notes from Procurement: 

- They prefer the PO to show an invoice schedule (dates + line items) rather than % only.
- Legal will want a short addendum clarifying data handling for the private offer (we can send standard language).
- Can you confirm if we can apply the commit to multiple projects within our org (we have separate billing accounts)?

Procurement has looped me on a shortlist of questions — I've attached their initial checklist (see procurement email). We'd like the PO + schedule by EOD Thursday so we can route internally and hit our finance cutoff on Aug 25.

Aisha

Aisha Rahman

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-08-14T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial drawdown sprint proposal for GCP private offer

Folks — looping in GCP so we can align the marketplace redemption window with HorizonAI's billing account model. Quick notes: 

- GCP confirmed private offers can be scoped to multiple billing accounts if we set the entitlement at the organization level; they will need the org-id and the final SKU mapping.
- There is a ~48–72 hour lead time for the co-sell listing to reflect the private offer after redemption. We should plan communications to Horizon's procurement so they understand that marketing/case study activities should be scheduled after the redemption clears.

Action items for Redwood:
- Michael: update the drawdown sheet to include exact invoice dates (Ben suggests 1st of month cadence).
- Marissa: produce an addendum snippet for data handling to attach to the PO.
- Ben: request org-id and billing account list from Aisha (or Procurement).

I'll schedule a 30-min sync for Monday to finalize the artifacts.

Ben
Sales Ops, Redwood Inference

From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@horizonai.com>, Procurement <procurement@horizonai.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, GCP Marketplace rep <gcp-ams@google.com>
Date: 2026-08-15T16:02:00-07:00
Subject: Final PO + invoice-date drawdown schedule (requested edits)

Aisha / Procurement team —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Attached are: (1) redwood_po_template.pdf with invoice dates filled (1st of each month), and (2) drawdown_schedule_v1.xlsx updated with line-item mapping and frontload math. Marissa included a 2-paragraph data handling addendum at the bottom of the PO.

Summary of the agreed approach: 
- PO shows invoice dates: 2026-09-01 (20%), 2026-10-01 (25%), 2026-11-01 (25%), 2026-12-01 (30% contingent on utilization).
- Commitment is redeemable across HorizonAI billing accounts under org-id X-ORG-778 (Ben, please confirm once you have the list).
- GCP listing will be requested after redemption completes; expected 48–72 hour propagation.

Please confirm if the PO looks good to route to Legal/Finance. If you approve, we can also attach a short statement for your purchasing system to speed the sign-off.

Thanks,
Michael

--
Michael Grant
Head of Sales, Cloud Partnerships
